title: LAPT-Scale: Scaling Embodied Policies with Latent Action Pre-Training on Human Videos
abstract: arXiv:2610.13732v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Scaling generalist robotic policies is limited by the high cost of collecting embodied interaction data. Large-scale egocentric human videos offer a rich alternative, but they lack robot action labels, and existing action annotation methods are often noisy under real-world visual complexity and diverse manipulation dynamics. We introduce LAPT-Scale, a scalable latent action pre-training paradigm with two components: LAPT-Scale-LAM learns continuous latent actions by explaining frame-to-frame visual transitions in human videos and uses them as human-derived supervision, while LAPT-Scale-Policy trains a VLA policy through human-video latent-action pre-training, target-robot embodiment alignment, and task-specific post-training. Unlike prior vector-quantized LAMs, LAPT-Scale-LAM uses a continuous latent space to preserve fine-grained motion and interaction dynamics. translated_title: LAPT-Scale：通过在人类视频上进行潜在动作预训练来扩展具身策略
translated_abstract: 摘要：通用机器人策略的扩展受限于具身交互数据收集的高昂成本。大规模的自我中心人类视频提供了一种丰富的替代方案，但其缺乏机器人动作标签，且现有的动作标注方法在真实世界视觉复杂性和多样化操作动态下往往存在噪声。我们提出了LAPT-Scale，这是一种可扩展的潜在动作预训练范式，包含两个组件：LAPT-Scale-LAM通过解释人类视频中帧到帧的视觉转换来学习连续潜在动作，并将其作为源自人类的监督信号；LAPT-Scale-Policy则通过人类视频潜在动作预训练、目标机器人具身对齐以及任务特定的后训练来训练VLA策略。与先前的向量量化LAM不同，LAPT-Scale-LAM采用连续潜在空间来保留细粒度的运动和交互动态。我们进一步结合了感知、语义和光流对齐信号
tldr: 提出LAPT-Scale范式，通过在人类视频上学习连续潜在动作进行预训练，并结合机器人具身对齐与任务后训练，从而以低成本扩展通用机器人VLA策略的能力。
en_tdlr: LAPT-Scale introduces a scalable latent action pre-training paradigm that learns continuous latent actions from human videos and aligns them with robot embodiment to scale generalist VLA policies at low cost.
